content: Ar Paulos ḍõr šobar mikka šuza saiyore hodde, "Oh báiyain okkol, aijja foijjonto ãi har Allar hamot ãr zimmare hono suwal sara falon goijji."
Ei hota funiyore ḍõr imam Ananiyase Paulosor ḍake zara tiyai aššil hitarare Paulosor galot suwar maribolla hokum diye.
Hetunot Paulose Ananiyasore hodde, "Munafek, Allaye tũware o šasti dibo. Ain mozin bisar goribolla tũi o heṛe boiššo, kintu ãre maribolla hokum diyore to tũi nize ain bangor!"
Zara Paulosor ḍake tiyai aššil hitara Paulosore hodde, "Tui Allar ekzon ḍõr imamore ofoman goror!"

Hetunot Paulose hodde, "Báiyain okkol hiba ḍõr imamde hiyan to ãi no zanitam. Zodi zanitam toile ki ãi ei hota hoitam ne, kiyollahoile pak kitabot endilla leka ase: 'Tũwar zatir netar berudde bura hota no hoiyo.'"

Tarfore Paulose he ḍõr šobar ek dol ze Sadduki ar ek dol Foroši, ei hota zaniyore Paulose ḍõr šobat maze guzori hodde, "Ãr báiyain okkol, ãi ekzon Foroši edde forošir fuwa. Mora okkol uwafes zinda oibode hiyanore aša goijji boli ãttu bisarot tiya foijje."
Paulosor ei hotar zoriya Foroši edde Sadduki okkolor maze ek hoijja šuru oiye. Ar henot šobar manuš okkol dui bag oigiyegoi.
Kiyollahoile Sadduki okkole hodde, heṛe hono uwafes zinda nai, hono firista nai, heṛe hono ruh nai, kintu Foroši okkole in okkolore biššaš gore.

Henot heṛe beši gulmal šuru oiye. Foroši dolor hoekzon alem uṛi beši hora gori bara bari suru gori diye. Hitara hodde, "Ãra ei manušwar hono hosuri no fair. Oitfare hono ruh otóba hono firistaye itar loi hota hoiye."

He hoijja endilla doro oiye, šena okkolor komonḍare ḍoraiye ze hitara Paulosore siri ṭura ṭura gori felaibo, hetolla hite šena okkolore hokum diye zene hitara zai manuš okkolor hatottu Paulosore surai loi fuliš berekot loi ane.
Tarforor din raitta Malik Isa Paulosor ḍake tiyaiyore hodde,

content.text: "Himmotwala o! Zeruzalemot zendilla tui ãr babute goba diyos, hendilla Rom šohorot o tottu ãr babute goba diya foribo."

content: Paulosore marifelaibar sail
Tarforor din binna sore Ihudi okkole ekkan sail goijje edde Paulosore hitara marifelai no fare foijjonto kissu no háibo hoi hosom háiye.
Sališzonottuwaro beši manuše ei sail goijje.
Hitara ḍõr imam edde murubbi okkolor hãse zai hodde, "Paulosore marifela no o foijjonto kissu no háiyum hoi ãra doro hosom háiyi.

Ehon tũwara edde ḍõr šobar manuš okkole aro bala gori zera goribolla hoi bahana dehai Paulosore tũwarar sarme anibolla šena okkolor komonḍaror hãse hóbor defeṛo. Hite eṛe fõsibar age ãra hitare furai felaibolla tiyar oi roiyi."
Kintu Paulosor boinor fuwaye ei sailor hóbor funiyore fuliš berekot giye edde Paulosore he hóbor hoiye.
Hetunot Paulose ekzon šenare ḍakiyore hodde, "Ei fuwaware komonḍaror hãse loi zo. Itattu hibar hãse kissu hoibar ase."
Toi hite hitare komonḍaror hãse loigiye.
Hetunot šena komonḍare he zuwan fuwawar hat sai dori ek ḍaikka loizai fusar goredde, "Tui ãre ki hoito sodde?"
He zuwan fuwawaye hodde: "Kissu Ihudiye Paulosor babute aro bala gori zera goribolla hoi bahana gori hibare aiyedde hailla ḍõr šobar sarme loi zaibolla õnor hãse foriyad goribo.

Õne hitarar hotat razi no oiyo, kiyollahoile sališzonottuwaro besi manuše Paulosor entezarot ase. Paulosore marifelai no fare foijjonto ei manuš okkole kissu no háibo hoi hosom háiye. Hitara ehon tiyar oi roiye, šude õne hitarar foriyadot razi oiba he entezarot ase."
Šena komonḍare he zuwan fuwaware zaito ejazot diye kintu endilla hũšiyari diye, "Ei hota ze tui ãr hãse zanaiyos hiyan honokiyore no hois!"
Paulosore Sesariya faṭai diya or
Šena komonḍare hitar duizon šenare ḍaki hodde, "Dui šot šoinno, hoittorzon gũrar suwari edde dui šot songinwala šoinno raitor nowa baze Sesariya zaibolla tiyar goro.
Ar Paulosolla o gũrar bebosta goro zene hitare o nirafodor sãte govarnar Feliksor hãse loiza za."
Bade komonḍare endilla ekkan šeṛi leikke:
Ãi, Klaudius Lysiyas, ḍõr ijjotwala govarnar Feliksor hãse. Ãr solam goisso.
Ihudi okkole ei manušware dori onumanik marifelaito sailde šomot ãi ãr soinno okkol loi zai hitare hentu uddar gori ainni, kiyollahoile ãi zani faijjilam ze hite ekzon Romiyo nagorik.
Bade ãi zainto sailam kiyolla hitara itare hosurbon gorer, hetolla hitarar ḍõr šobar hãse ãi itare loi gilam.
Ãi buzi faijjilam ze hitarar ainor hotabattara loi hitara itare hosurbon goijje, kintu moribar otóba ziyolot zaibar laikka hen hono hosuri ite no gore.

Ãi zehon zani farilam ze mainše ei manušwar berudde sail goijje, hiyanor zoriya hitare ãi õnor hãse defeṛailam. Zara hitare duši gorer hitarare o ãi hokum diyi zene hitara itar hosurir babute õnor hãse ho.
Toi soinno okkole šena komonḍaror hokum mozin Paulosore raitta hitarar fũwati Antipatris šohor foijjonto loigiye.
Tarfordin hitara gũrar suwari soinno okkolor fũwati Paulosore faṭai diyore hitara berekot firi aigiyegoi.
Gũrar suwari okkol Sesariyat fõsi bade šeṛigan edde Paulosore Govarnoror hatot diye.
Governore šeṛigan fori bade Paulos hon elehar manuš fusar goijje. Paulos ze Kilikiya elehar manuš hiyan zani fariyore
hite hodde, "Tore zara hosurbon goijje hitara eṛe fõsilegai ãi tor hota funiyum." Bade hite badša Herudor górot Paulosore fahara diyore sõi goribolla hokum diye.
